scope: Compile one exact pricing window into a serial single-GPU engineering harness; no dispatch, baseline qualification, candidate test, or scientific claim.

execution.environment_policy: exact current native schema, interpreter, GPU UUID, package identities, and hashed dependency inventory

required_guards: recompute the canonical pricing receipt and its transitive evidence before plan creation
retain exact priced UID order and window membership
run every UID through the Full128 complete-unit runner mode
use attempt-relative repository paths after harness staging
stop workload scheduling at 27000 seconds so the final 1800 seconds remain unavailable to tasks
retain all failed and timed-out UIDs in the denominator
do not emit into an existing plan directory
require a hash-bound reconciliation for population-gpu-current-r9 before every plan generation
accept exactly the retained r9 handoff in this compiler revision; require reviewed code before adding any later retained run
require ordered complete dispositions for every retained source-run population range
derive dispositions with the canonical reconciliation builder from the hash-bound r9 research-harness state snapshot; never infer task identity from aggregate counts

parse the canonical r9 campaign plan, aggregate status and harness state, recompute the harness digest, verify each native-plan SHA-256 and plan digest, and match run ID, range, tasks, observation time, aggregate counts and every individual task state
reject a target window that intersects any completed, running, pending, or failed retained UID
retain all reconciliation source references in every native input closure
stage validated historical campaign/native JSON as opaque byte-pinned evidence rather than rebasing original inner paths against the current project root
freeze and inspect the exact harness digest before any later Local execution
